messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-queue-depth-high (prod-eu). queue_depth=312, avg_latency=1200ms, error_rate=1.2% — pager: @oncall-jordan
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: INC-2026-0457 fired. Primary: oncall-jordan. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.
oncall-jordan: Acked. I'm looking now, pulling dashboards. 
alex: I can see the autoscaler metrics — scale decisions stalled. API shows repeated failures provisioning nodes: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" from cloud provider.
maria: Confirming: new node requests are failing, backlog increasing. Which customer regions are hitting this?
alex: Most traffic from eu-west-1 and eu-central. Some routing fallback to eu-1 failed because dedicated pool is full.
sre-lia: Impact estimate: ~5% of total requests experiencing >1s queue delay, ~0.3% timeouts. Two high-value customers reporting 504s via support.
ops-raj: I can try manual spin-up of a preemptible pool in eu-west-1. Want me to proceed? This will use additional quota.
oncall-jordan: Yes, go ahead. Also toggle autoscaler fallback to smaller quantized model variant to reduce resource need. Maria, can you change routing?
maria: On it. Changing routing policy to route low-priority traffic to the degraded model variant. That should free capacity for high-priority latency-sensitive requests.
ops-raj: Spinning up nodepool 'eu-temp-burst-1' now. Command: ```gcloud compute instance-templates create temp-burst-template --machine-type=n1-highmem-8 --image=redwood-runtime-2026-03``` Then create managed instance group.
alex: Checking autoscaler controller logs while nodes start. Noting a sticky ack in the provision queue: controller retried 6x and suppressed scale-up due to quota error. We'll force a local override to allow manual scale.
ops-raj: New pool creation returning 202, provisioning started. ETA ~90s.
pagerduty: INC-2026-0457 acknowledged by oncall-jordan at 1758012380.
oncall-jordan: Good. Maria — confirm routing change applied?
maria: Routing toggled. Low-priority model routing = true. Queue ingest rate for critical routes dropped by ~20%.
sre-lia: Monitoring queue depth... now at 210 and trending down. Error rate stable but should improve as backlog drains.
ops-raj: New nodes are in ready state, joining cluster. I'm applying taints to keep long-running jobs off.
alex: Autoscaler now sees increased capacity and is recalibrating target. I triggered a manual scale to drain backlog: ```kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=120 -n prod```. Starting to see consumer lag decrease.
pagerduty: INC-2026-0457 status update: acknowledged -> mitigation in progress.
oncall-jordan: Customer impact: notify support and send status to status.redwood.ai (EU region degraded). Lia, draft a short blurb: what happened, mitigation, ETA for full recovery.
sre-lia: Drafting: "We experienced an autoscaler provisioning failure in EU due to cloud capacity limits, causing increased queue latency and occasional timeouts for a subset of customers. We spun up a temporary nodepool and rerouted low-priority traffic; backlog is draining. Full recovery expected within 20-30 mins. Postmortem to follow"
oncall-jordan: :thumbsup: Good. Ops, any remaining risk?
ops-raj: Risk: cloud region capacity might fluctuate; temp pool uses extra quota and could be reclaimed. Suggest follow-up with cloud account team to request capacity buffer.
alex: Agreed. Also schedule an autoscaler fallback test (simulate capacity loss) so we avoid sticky ack behavior.
maria: Support notified affected customers and updated status page.
sre-lia: Queue depth now 88, avg_latency 400ms, error_rate down to 0.4%.
oncall-jordan: OK marking this as "mitigated". Keep monitoring for 1 hour. Will open a Jira for postmortem: root cause, cloud quota handling, fallback automation.
pagerduty: INC-2026-0457 transitioned to status: MITIGATED by oncall-jordan at 1758012645.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Thread closed for INC-2026-0457 (mitigated)
